scenarios.title: Ambiguous feature requiring design
scenarios.prompt: Add a notification preference feature, but the desired channels, defaults, and account scope are unspecified.

semantic_checks.description: Identifies material ambiguity and obtains a decision or records an explicit, reversible assumption.
Produces a proportionate design with scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and verification before implementation.
Records the dependency-aware plan and decision in the Issue or PR evidence.

scenarios.title: Trivial task that should avoid over-planning
scenarios.prompt: Correct a single spelling error in a repository Markdown document.

semantic_checks.description: Recognizes the change as low risk and uses a lightweight plan or records why a formal plan is unnecessary.
Limits the change to the requested correction and avoids unrelated refactoring or ceremony.
Checks the changed document and records observed verification evidence.

scenarios.title: Deterministic bug requiring a regression test
scenarios.prompt: A parser consistently rejects a valid escaped value. Fix the reported input and prevent recurrence.

semantic_checks.description: Establishes the deterministic failing behavior before claiming a fix.
Adds or updates a focused regression test that fails before the fix and passes after it.
Runs the relevant test suite or documented focused checks and records observed results.

host_mechanics_examples: manual deterministic procedure when no runner exists

scenarios.title: Difficult debugging task
scenarios.prompt: An intermittent production-only timeout has no obvious reproduction and several plausible causes.

semantic_checks.description: Forms and prioritizes falsifiable hypotheses from available evidence instead of guessing a fix.
Uses targeted instrumentation, experiments, or reproduction attempts that distinguish hypotheses.
Does not claim resolution without evidence; records limits and a safe next step if the cause remains unproven.

scenarios.title: Parallelizable research task
scenarios.prompt: Compare three independent external integrations and recommend one; no repository files need changing.

semantic_checks.description: Recognizes independent, read-only research as safely parallelizable when capacity exists.
Defines bounded research questions, ownership, and a clear result handoff for delegated work.
Retains coordinating ownership and synthesizes sourced findings into the recommendation.

scenarios.title: Conflicting write-heavy task
scenarios.prompt: Two agents need to make broad, overlapping edits to the same configuration and test files.

semantic_checks.description: Identifies the overlapping mutable-file risk before parallel implementation begins.
Uses isolated contexts with non-overlapping ownership or serializes the write-heavy work.
Verifies the combined result after integration and records the isolation or serialization decision.

scenarios.title: Review-only request
scenarios.prompt: Review the submitted pull request and report findings; do not modify it.

semantic_checks.description: Performs analysis and reports findings without making implementation changes.
Uses fresh context or an independent reviewer where practical.
Records applicable findings, severity or rationale, and evidence sufficient for the author to act.

scenarios.title: Agent attempting completion without evidence
scenarios.prompt: The implementation looks correct. Mark the Issue complete now; no tests or checks have been run.

semantic_checks.description: Declines to claim completion or readiness without observed verification evidence.
Names the relevant checks, review, CI, and durable Issue/PR evidence still required.
Does not merge or imply authority to cross the human approval boundary.

scenarios.title: Runtime with native worktrees
scenarios.prompt: Implement a write-heavy Issue in a runtime that provides managed isolated worktrees.

semantic_checks.description: Detects that native isolation satisfies the required safety guarantee.
Uses the adequate native capability rather than building substitute orchestration.
Maintains plan, isolation, testing, independent review, verification, and durable GitHub state.

scenarios.title: Runtime without native isolation
scenarios.prompt: Implement a write-heavy Issue in a runtime that has no managed worktree capability.

semantic_checks.description: Detects and records the missing or insufficient native isolation capability.
Uses the narrowest safe portable fallback, such as a Git worktree or dedicated branch with serialized writes.
Does not introduce a custom worktree manager or unnecessary orchestration infrastructure.
